title: Saffron Lentil Bowl with Japanese Twist
description: A hearty, comforting bowl of saffron-infused lentils topped with crispy tempura bits, a nod to the bold flavors of Japan.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and soak them in water for at least 30 minutes.
In a large saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, saffron, and water to the saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
While the lentils are cooking, prepare the tempura bits. Heat about 1-2 inches of oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the tempura bits until crispy and golden brown.
Strain the lentils and discard the excess liquid. Add the cornstarch and stir to combine.
To serve, place a scoop of the lentils in a bowl and top with crispy tempura bits, green onions, and sesame seeds.
Garnish with additional green onions and sesame seeds, if desired.
